map: hmcp_bodega -- a corner shop. The prose half of this brief is brief.md, beside it.

rules.note: Two people meeting at a doorway should not have to take turns.
A room whose widest point is narrow is a corridor that has been mislabelled.
A shop with a low ceiling reads as a basement.
About 15 m2. Below that it is a cupboard, not a room.
A customer stands in front of the till. 48 units is one person, not a queue.
The one sight line the shop is arranged around.
What is behind the counter is the shop's business, not the street's.
